decisions.reason: Piqué upholstery fabric builds closely on existing weaving know-how, so despite reduced website prominence the firm can interpret early results and improve the product.
The semi-transparent bouclé-effect fabric is less aligned with the firm's core upholstery and curtain capabilities and only briefly mentioned, limiting the firm's ability to learn and improve.
Flame-retardant dotted jacquard curtain fabric matches strong existing jacquard and finishing knowledge and its sustained own-page presence signals interpretable success.
Double-face wool-blend decoration fabric is moderately related to existing weaving and despite subdued marketing can be improved through the firm's technical knowledge.
The semi-transparent wool bouclé leno fabric uses a leno technique that is far from the firm's established processes and weak early results hamper learning.
Braided-structure upholstery and curtain fabric is less related but its strong own-page launch suggests market recognition and the firm can invest in acquiring the knowledge to improve.
